accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64], x: i64) -> bool { (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> 0 <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= 1000000000) && 0 <= x && x <= 1000000000 }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], r: usize) -> bool { r <= a.len() && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> 0 <= #[trigger] a[k] && a[k] <= 1000000000) }
